paragraphs: Rav Zuti, in chapter Hakometz, in Rav Ashi’s time. He understood Zuti as a sage’s name and Rav as the title. Although a sage named Rav Zuti does exist, as I shall write shortly below—Yuchasin omitted him and did not list him—the one in Hakometz, in Rav Ashi’s time, is Rabbah Zuti (see his entry), mentioned many times in the Talmud.
